cues.en: There are both specific and general criticisms of mechanistic interpretability.
cues.zh: 機制可解釋性，有具體與一般批評。

cues.en: The specific criticisms are related to specific analysis methods and findings, and I will discuss those
cues.zh: 具體批評針對分析、發現，會在

cues.en: over the next several sections of the course as I introduce each of the methods.
cues.zh: 後幾章逐一介紹方法時談。

cues.en: But what I want to do in this video is introduce you to some general criticisms that people have made
cues.zh: 這支先介紹，大家對

cues.en: about the field of AI in general, or its relation to technical AI safety.
cues.zh: AI 領域，或它與技術安全關係的一般批評。

cues.en: I am presenting them here so you can keep them in the back of your mind while learning about the methods over the next few sections.
cues.zh: 讓你後面學方法時，記在心裡。

cues.en: I think criticisms are great and should be taken seriously and embraced as challenges for making things better.
cues.zh: 批評很好，該認真看待，當成改善挑戰。

cues.en: Honestly, anything worth doing is worth criticizing and as long as the criticisms are respectful and professional.
cues.zh: 值得做的事，就值得批評；只要尊重、專業，

cues.en: Then it's really one of the most important mechanisms for progress in science, engineering and technology.
cues.zh: 就是科學、工程、科技進步的重要機制。

cues.en: I do have my own personal opinions about several of the criticisms here, but I'm trying not to interject
cues.zh: 我對幾點有個人看法，但盡量不

cues.en: my own opinion because I want you to be able to form your own opinions and then refine your opinions and your thoughts as you continue working through the course.
cues.zh: 介入，希望你形成意見，再隨課程修正。

cues.en: The first general criticism I'll discuss is called cherry picking.
cues.zh: 第一，挑選有利結果，cherry-picking。

cues.en: If you have a background in statistics, then I'm sure you are familiar with this term.
cues.zh: 學過統計，應該熟悉。

cues.en: If you don't, then unfortunately this does not refer to hanging out on a farm in the summer and eating delicious little fruits.
cues.zh: 不然，很遺憾，不是夏天在農場吃櫻桃。

cues.en: Instead, cherry picking refers to sifting through a lot of analyses and handpicking a very small number
cues.zh: 而是從大量分析中，刻意挑少數

cues.en: of results that look really compelling and tell a great story.
cues.zh: 很有說服力、能講好故事的結果。

cues.en: The problem with cherry picking is that you might be picking non-reproducible, statistical flukes,
cues.zh: 可能挑到無法重現的統計偶然，

cues.en: or even if you do cherry pick a real effect, it might not be a very meaningful or generalizable effect, except that it fits into a story that you want to tell.
cues.zh: 就算是真效果，也未必重要、可泛化，只是適合想說的故事。

cues.en: Either way, cherry picking is bad statistical practice, and it does happen in mech interp research, just like it happens in basically every area of science.
cues.zh: 這是不良統計實務，這領域會發生，其他科學也會，

cues.en: Even fundamental mathematical physics.
cues.zh: 甚至基本數學物理。

cues.en: The next general criticism is difficulties with reproducibility.
cues.zh: 接著是可重現性困難。

cues.en: This refers to when someone reports a finding, but other people cannot replicate their findings.
cues.zh: 有人報告發現，別人卻重做不出。

cues.en: Or maybe there is a finding that really does work and is reproducible in one data set and for one particular
cues.zh: 或在某資料、某模型有效、可重現，

cues.en: model, but it falls apart for a different data set or different tokens or different models.
cues.zh: 換資料、詞元、模型就崩潰。

cues.en: Difficulties with reproducibility is certainly not unique to mech interp.
cues.zh: 並非這領域特有。

cues.en: It is an extremely common issue in many areas of science that involve complex systems.
cues.zh: 複雜系統科學非常常見。

cues.en: That includes biology, experimental physics, psychology, medicine, and so on.
cues.zh: 生物、實驗物理、心理、醫學等等。

cues.en: On the other hand, we should not abandon an area of research just because we haven't yet figured out what findings are reproducible.
cues.zh: 但不能只因尚不知哪些可重現，就放棄領域。

cues.en: That's especially true in a new field like AI.
cues.zh: AI 這種新領域尤其如此。

cues.en: If we took this criticism in medicine, modern medical technology would be basically the same as it was in the 18th century.
cues.zh: 若醫學也這樣，現代技術還會停在十八世紀。

cues.en: As I mentioned in the previous video, most mechanistic interpretability takes a strong bottom up,
cues.zh: 如上一支，多數機制研究偏由下而上、

cues.en: reductionist approach where we start from the lowest level features that we can measure, like weights.
cues.zh: 還原式，從可測最低層開始，例如權重、

cues.en: Neurons.
cues.zh: 神經元、

cues.en: Single token activations.
cues.zh: 單一詞元啟用。

cues.en: It is possible that llms simply do not represent information at this level, but instead use more abstracted,
cues.zh: LLM 可能不在這個層級表徵資訊，而用更抽象、

cues.en: more distributed, or latent structures.
cues.zh: 分散、潛在的結構。

cues.en: If that's the case, then we might just fail to find any meaningful breakthroughs relating the low level
cues.zh: 那可能找不到突破，把低階

cues.en: mechanisms to complex emergent behaviors demonstrated by llms.
cues.zh: 機制連到複雜湧現行為。

cues.en: By analogy, it is very unlikely that we will understand the complexities of human behavior by studying electrons in a particular neuron in a brain.
cues.zh: 類比來說，研究腦中某神經元的電子，很難理解人類行為複雜性。

cues.en: On the other hand, giving up too early can be an even bigger mistake.
cues.zh: 但太早放棄，可能更錯。

cues.en: There are many important developments in other areas of science and engineering and mathematics, where
cues.zh: 其他科學、工程、數學，

cues.en: we have made a ton of progress by pursuing reductionist approaches, even despite criticisms from contemporary scientists.
cues.zh: 即使當代有人批評，仍靠還原法大幅進步。

cues.en: Okay, this title here is quite a mouthful, but basically it means that principles that are discovered
cues.zh: 這個標題很拗口，基本上是說，

cues.en: in very small toy models might not hold for larger, state of the art.
cues.zh: 小玩具模型的原理，未必適用大型前沿模型。

cues.en: This would be a lack of universality.
cues.zh: 就是缺乏普遍性。

cues.en: So people often study small and simple models under the belief that the simplicity and the tractability
cues.zh: 常研究小、簡單模型，相信其簡單、可處理性，

cues.en: of a toy model allows for understanding the essence of larger and more complex models.
cues.zh: 能理解更大、更複雜模型的本質。

cues.en: But the problem is that the complex models might be just too fundamentally different from the smaller models for any valid generalization.
cues.zh: 但複雜模型，可能根本差太多，無法有效泛化。

cues.en: An analogy here is that when you study Newtonian motion in a high school physics class, there's no friction.
cues.zh: 例如高中牛頓力學，沒有摩擦，

cues.en: There's no interactions between multiple different bodies, there's no quantum effects, etc. and so
cues.zh: 沒有多物體交互作用、量子效應等等。

cues.en: on the one hand, it is a fair criticism to say that this imaginary world where Newtonian physics works perfectly, that doesn't reflect the real world that we live in.
cues.zh: 一方面，批評它只是理想世界，不反映現實，是合理的。

cues.en: But on the other hand, you can learn a lot about physics from studying simple, imaginary Newtonian
cues.zh: 但另一方面，簡單假想的牛頓

cues.en: systems, and we would not have an understanding of quantum mechanics today if there was never a Newtonian
cues.zh: 系統能教很多；若沒有牛頓

cues.en: mechanics, because people just said, well, it's too simplistic, so let's just drop the whole thing.
cues.zh: 力學，因太簡單就放棄，也不會有今日量子力學。

cues.en: The criticism here on this slide is that there hasn't yet been any very clear, obvious and non refutable
cues.zh: 這張批評是，目前還沒有非常清楚、明顯、無可反駁的

cues.en: impacts of mech Interp research on AI safety in the real world.
cues.zh: 機制研究，對真實 AI 安全的影響。

cues.en: And as I mentioned a few videos ago, it is possible that if we had redirected Erected all of the resources
cues.zh: 幾支前說過，若把投入

cues.en: that go to make Interp into AI safety, then we would be further along on practical and implementable
cues.zh: 機制研究的資源，全轉安全，也許實務、可實作

cues.en: safety issues.
cues.zh: 安全問題已進展更多。

cues.en: Honestly though, a criticism like this assumes that there is literally one purpose to make interp research, which is to immediately and directly benefit AI safety.
cues.zh: 但這假定研究唯一目的，就是立刻、直接改善安全。

cues.en: That is one of the goals of mech Interp.
cues.zh: 那是目標之一。

cues.en: But mech Interp is a challenging and complex and also very new field.
cues.zh: 但它困難、複雜，也很新，

cues.en: It is multifaceted.
cues.zh: 有多面向。

cues.en: There are multiple mech Interp researchers who are exploring models for various purposes, not necessarily
cues.zh: 許多研究者為不同目的探索，未必

cues.en: all related to immediately implementable AI safety advancements.
cues.zh: 都關於立即可實作的安全進展。

cues.en: And furthermore, because mech interp is so new, it is possible that there will be important impacts once the field has matured enough.
cues.zh: 而且領域新，成熟後可能有重要影響。

cues.en: Well, I hope you are not dissuaded by the criticisms here.
cues.zh: 希望這些批評沒讓你卻步。

cues.en: As a former academic, scientist and professor, I can tell you that doing difficult research also requires
cues.zh: 身為前學者、科學家、教授，可以說，做困難研究，

cues.en: a thick skin and the ability to understand criticism not as a personal attack, but as a challenge to work towards better research.
cues.zh: 也要有抗壓性，理解批評不是人身攻擊，而是改善挑戰。

cues.en: On the other hand, there is also a fine line that needs to be balanced because it's hard to know when
cues.zh: 但也要平衡，很難知道，

cues.en: a particular line of research is difficult but promising, and you just need to persevere and keep trying
cues.zh: 某方向只是難、仍有希望，需要堅持，

cues.en: until you reach success, versus when something just really doesn't work and you're better off investing your time into other areas that might be more promising.
cues.zh: 直到成功；還是真的不行，時間該投到其他更有潛力的地方。

cues.en: Well, with those general criticisms out of the way, let's move to the next part of this course and
cues.zh: 談完一般批評，進下一部分，

cues.en: start learning about these specific analyses and interpretations of token embeddings.
cues.zh: 開始學詞元嵌入的具體分析、解讀。
